capstones.name: Brutal Onslaught Discipline
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, +40% damage, +20% attack speed, +15% accuracy. Cannot be disarmed.
capstones.description: The warrior's onslaught is brutal and unrelenting.

capstones.name: Valorous Rage
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, +35% damage vs undead/evils, +20% attack speed, immune to fear.

capstones.name: Unholy Aura Discipline
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, Harm Touch damage +100%, +25% lifetap effectiveness, aura damages nearby enemies.
capstones.description: Unholy aura radiates from the shadowknight.

capstones.name: Crane Stance
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, +30% damage, +25% dodge, attacks cannot be riposted.
capstones.description: The monk assumes the crane stance — untouchable.

capstones.name: Knifeplay Discipline
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, thrown damage +50%, melee +25%, +20% chance to double attack.
capstones.description: The rogue's knifeplay is a deadly art.

capstones.name: Blinding Fury
capstones.effect: For 60 seconds, +70% damage, +30% attack speed. Blind to defense (take +30% damage).
capstones.description: Blinding fury — offense is the only defense.

capstones.name: Guardian of the Forest
capstones.effect: For 3 minutes, +25% mitigation, +20% damage, track shows all enemies. Forest protects.
capstones.description: The forest itself guards the ranger.

capstones.name: Roar of Thunder
capstones.effect: AE: 800 + (level × 8) sonic damage, -30% attack speed debuff for 1 minute, de-aggro 50%.
capstones.description: The beastlord's roar is thunder incarnate.

capstones.name: Song of Stone
capstones.effect: Group buff (5 min): 1000 HP damage absorb shield. Refreshes every 30 seconds.
capstones.description: The bard's song turns flesh to stone — unbreakable.

capstones.name: Sanctified Blessing
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, heals have 25% chance to also cure all effects and grant 300 HP shield.
capstones.description: Sanctified blessings flow through the cleric's hands.

capstones.name: Group Spirit of the Black Wolf
capstones.effect: Group buff (10 min): +50% run speed, +20% attack, see invisible. The black wolf's gift.
capstones.description: The black wolf's spirit carries the group swiftly.

capstones.name: Languid Bite
capstones.effect: Target: 60% slow + 300/tick poison DoT for 2 minutes. Cannot be resisted.
capstones.description: The shaman's bite is languid but lethal.

capstones.name: Haze
capstones.effect: AE: -35% accuracy, -20% attack speed for 90 seconds. 15% chance to mez on hit.
capstones.description: A haze of enchantment confuses the enemy.

capstones.name: Heart of Ice
capstones.effect: Aura (3 min): +300 cold damage per hit for self + pet. Cold immune. Enemies take 100/tick cold.
capstones.description: The magician's heart is ice — beautiful and deadly.

capstones.name: Death's Malaise
capstones.effect: Debuff: -25 to all resists, +20% DoT damage taken, -15% healing received for 3 minutes.

capstones.name: Silent Casting
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, spells generate 90% less hate. Can cast without interruption.
capstones.description: The wizard casts in perfect silence — death unseen.
